audit_items.proof_trace: The `end()` function carries the `whenRaiseNotEnded` modifier, which calls `_verifyCapitalRaiseHasNotEnded()` (L632-634); that function reverts with `LegionSale__SaleHasEnded` if `s_capitalRaiseStatus.hasEnded == true`. Since `end()` sets `hasEnded = true` and no other code path resets it to `false`, every subsequent invocation is blocked. The same one-way guard is present in the related variants (`LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale` via a local private override, `LegionPreLiquidOpenApplicationSale` via an `override` of the base virtual function), both checking their respective `hasEnded` flags.
